# Retained model-workflow definitions

`legacy-workflow.json` was captured through public author/save/read commands with the unchanged
writer at `c1c3d046c845c7763bd24162141fb3855518360e` (only assignment registration and capture
tests had changed). It contains two model steps, workflow-input and earlier-result bindings,
acceptance routing and the old colon-concatenated edge identities. It is frozen evidence, not
generated by the current builder. The public legacy test pins its revision ID and content digest.

`legacy-repair-proposal.json` was captured in the same unchanged-writer run through the actual CLI
repair operation. Its fixed mutation batch contains the old edge IDs, terminal retargeting and
`failed_result` evidence port. The repair regression validates the full frozen proposal, then binds
those exact mutations to the test's fresh paused run and rejected-attempt evidence. It pins the
old mutation ID and resulting semantic digest, and verifies approval/application and retained
proposal/command replay after restart. It does not reuse the captured run's timestamp-based attempt
ID as evidence of the new test run.

The reader accepts these IDs only for their exact endpoints and rebuilds the full editor shape.
No-op reads/saves preserve the document; a child preserves unchanged connections and gives new
connections current IDs. Arbitrary IDs and richer shapes still refuse convenience editing.
